description:
dedupe_job_facts (src/compiler2/world.rs) builds a HashSet and a Vec<bool> per call, twice per job completion.

Measured on the OptionParser probe (5,100 calls): 253 empty lists, 2,806 of one fact, 651 of two, 90% at most eight, maximum 84; 504 calls contained a repeat.

Built: a list shorter than two facts is returned untouched (3,059 of 5,100 calls). Longer lists are deduplicated as before. A scan of the kept prefix in place of the set was built and rejected: it is quadratic in list length and lists reach 84 facts on this probe alone.

Result: 844,040 -> 838,419 allocations on the probe; output and canon identical.
title: A job fact list that cannot hold a repeat is returned as it is
